speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to understand the underlying cause, where exactly do you feel your coordination issues are most severe, and have you noticed any changes in your speech or swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for describing those symptoms; the feeling of being "drunk" while walking and clumsiness on the right side are concerning. To narrow this down, do you have any family history of similar neurological conditions, or have you ever noticed any involuntary movements or tremors?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy in a patient with Crohn's disease.
